title: GOAT Listing Stale Inventory
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goat:listing listing_status="active" days_listed=*
| where days_listed>45
| stats count as stale_listings, avg(list_price_usd) as avg_price by sku
| sort - stale_listings
| head 15
description: Surfaces GOAT listings active for more than forty-five days without selling.
value: Stale listings usually mean price is too high or photos need refresh; visibility prevents forgotten inventory tax.
implementation: Export GOAT active listings with `days_listed` and review stale SKUs biweekly for repricing.
visualization: Table of stale listings by SKU with average list price.
grandmaExplanation: It spots sneakers listed on GOAT so long they probably need a price cut.
